• On October 20, 2026, Mount Logan Management LLC entered into a definitive agreement to become investment adviser to the AFA Asset Based Lending Fund, a roughly $230 million interval fund, which will be renamed the Mount Logan Asset Based Lending Fund upon closing (the “Proposed AFA Transaction”).

The transaction will bring the Company’s interval fund assets to approximately $460 million and is expected to be immediately accretive to FRE upon closing, which is expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the fund's shareholder and regulatory approvals.

The purchases will be executed through an independent broker-dealer, Mount Logan is not a counterparty to the plan, and BC Partners currently holds approximately 2% of the Company’s outstanding common stock.
A replay of the conference call and webcast will be available on-demand via the Company’s investor relations webpage at https://ir.mountlogan.com/ for 12 months.

The Company’s management believes FRE and SRE are useful in evaluating its operating performance and by providing these non-GAAP measures, the Company’s management intends to provide investors, securities analysts and other interested parties with a meaningful, consistent comparison of the Company’s profitability for the periods presented.
